attributes.title: reject_proposal
attributes.description: Marks the saved proposal as rejected and clears it from the review panel, when the user says it is wrong or asks to start over. Nothing is deleted -- already-created tags are untouched (use reset_demo_folder for those) and the proposal stays in the history. Revise and call save_proposal again to show a new one.

parameters.name: reason
parameters.description: Short note on what the user objected to, for the record.

parameters.name: proposal_id
parameters.description: Id returned by save_proposal. Omit to reject the most recent proposal.
